title: Strength level comparison choice can fail to save without a word
what: In the strength level sheet, tapping Everyone, Men or Women marks the chip at once and redraws the level. If saving the choice fails, only a log line is written: the member is not told, and the next time the page opens the old choice and the old level come back.
expected: The choice is shown as kept only once it is saved, or the member is told it could not be saved and can try again.
who: members who change who they are compared with
how_often: rarely, only when the phone's storage write fails
fix_line: Wait for the save before keeping the choice, and say so calmly when it fails
